overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation on any point: the chair lawfully limited public speakers, the minutes adequately summarized a submitted fact sheet, there was no pre-meeting deliberation, and the posted notice gave the correct start time. Non-OML inquiries were not addressed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board violated the OML by limiting public participation at its October 24, 2011 meeting to two speakers with one minute each.
allegations.key_passage: The Chairman had discretion under the Open Meeting Law to decide who could speak at the meeting, and therefore did not violate that law by allowing only two members of the public to speak for one minute at a time.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the minutes may be incomplete, specifically regarding a public member's 'fact sheet' submitted at the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The Board therefore complied with the Open Meeting Law by simply including in the minutes a summary of the discussion that took place regarding the submission of the "fact sheet" by a member of the public, and it was not required to include any further detail about that document's contents in the minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint speculated that Board members deliberated on the permit application before the October 24, 2011 meeting, outside an open session.
allegations.key_passage: In the absence of evidence to the contrary, we credit the Board's response and fmd that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by improperly deliberating in advance of the October 24, 2011 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged unclear notice of the meeting start time, after members announced 5:30 p.m. on October 17 while the posted notice said 5:00 p.m.
allegations.key_passage: Because the official meeting notice listed the correct time for the meeting, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant raised several inquiries about Board operations that the letter said do not pertain to the Open Meeting Law and were not addressed.
allegations.key_passage: The complainant makes several inquiries regarding the Board's operations that do not pertain to the Open Meeting Law, and therefore will not be addressed by this letter.
